# App Rotator

> Configurable, fail-closed Windows tray application that time-slices resource-heavy desktop apps: starts exactly one configured heavy app at a time, closes it gracefully after its allotted duration, waits through an empty inter-app gap to release VRAM and memory caches, and advances through the rotation loop.

- Repository: https://github.com/dev-bricks/app-rotator
- Organization: https://github.com/dev-bricks
- Umbrella Ecosystem: https://github.com/open-bricks
- License: MIT

- Language: Python >= 3.11 (Microsoft Windows only)
- Version: 0.2.3
- Last-checked: 2026-09-21
- Entry points: `app-rotator` CLI (`run`, `tray`, `play`, `pause`, `stop`, `status`, `config-init`, `config-validate`)
- State: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AppRotator\state.json`, events in `events.jsonl`, single-instance file lock (`app-rotator.lock`)
- Security: `SECURITY.md` (100% Local-First, Fail-Closed, Path-Restricted, Non-Elevation `RunAsInvoker`, Zero Network Egress, 48h Response SLA & 5-Day Triage Guarantee)
- Licenses: `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` (Level 1 SBOM, Invariant Cross-Reference Matrix, Pillow, psutil, pystray, pytest, ruff, setuptools)
- Marketing & Audit: `MARKETING-LOG.txt` (Pfad B Discoverability, 17-Point Bilingual Quick Navigation, Target Personas, 10-Dimension Comparative Matrix, Dual Mermaid Architecture, 10 Governance Invariants, § 521 BGB Statutory Disclaimer, Ecosystem Parity)
- CI: `.github/workflows/tests.yml` (Windows matrix across Python 3.11, 3.12, 3.13 with pip caching, ruff, compileall, and pytest)
- Documentation: `README.md` (EN, 17 navigation points, dual Mermaid diagrams, target personas, 10-dimension comparative matrix, § 521 BGB disclaimer), `README_de.md` (DE, 17 navigation points, dual Mermaid diagrams, target personas, 10-dimension comparative matrix, § 521 BGB disclaimer), `CHANGELOG.md`

## 10 Governance & Runtime Invariants

1. `INV-LOCAL-01`: 100% Local-First Privacy (Zero telemetry, zero analytics, zero external network egress).
2. `INV-UNPRIV-02`: Unprivileged User Space (`RunAsInvoker`, non-elevation).
3. `INV-DRYRUN-03`: Fail-Closed & Dry-Run by Default (`enabled: false`, `dry_run: true`).
4. `INV-SCOPING-04`: Path-Restricted Process Scoping (Requires executable name + strict path constraint `path_exact` or `path_contains`).
5. `INV-ATOMIC-05`: Atomic Persistence (State and mailbox writes execute via temporary file + atomic replacement).
6. `INV-DELEGATION-06`: Provider Delegation Contract (External provider automation controlled via external CLI: `pause-all`, `stagger-resume`, `cancel`).
7. `INV-LOCKFILE-07`: Single-Instance File Lock Protection (`app-rotator.lock` on tray and engine run).
8. `INV-AUMID-08`: Non-Invasive AppX Shell Activation (`explorer.exe shell:AppsFolder/<AUMID>`).
9. `INV-SYNC-09`: Cloud-Sync & Conflict Resilience (Runtime state outside cloud paths; `.gitignore` conflict filters).
10. `INV-SLA-10`: 48h Security SLA & 5-Day Triage Guarantee.

## Layout & Architecture

- `src/app_rotator/` — engine, controller, processes, settings, tray, config
- `src/app_rotator/assets/` — packaged high-resolution application icons
- `scripts/install-desktop-shortcut.ps1` — unprivileged per-user desktop installer below `%LOCALAPPDATA%`
- `tests/` — pytest test suite (passing contract & unit tests)
- `tests/test_metadata.py` — automated metadata contract tests verifying PEP 621, URLs, badges, 17-point quick navigation, reciprocal dual HTML anchors, target personas, 10-dimension comparative matrix, Level 1 SBOM, dual Mermaid diagrams, 10 invariants, ecosystem matrix, licenses, and SECURITY SLAs
